triggerReason: Deterministic runs and human approvals still lived in one browser, preventing shared observation, durable evidence, concurrent mutation safety, and trustworthy experiment recovery.
action: Added a server-owned experiment service, memory and PostgreSQL repositories, optimistic concurrency, append-only event cursors, periodic snapshots, scheduler-driven ticks, historical forks, SSE streaming, roles, audit records, and verified report bundles.
outcome: Experiments can now survive the browser, be replayed or branched from historical ticks, reject stale writers, stream evidence to observers, and export a self-contained verification report.
evidence: Real PostgreSQL 17 migration and repository integration test passes
The same browser workflow passes with memory and PostgreSQL backends
Stale expected versions are rejected instead of overwriting newer runs
Snapshots are stored at tick 0 and every five ticks
Historical forks pass deterministic report replay verification
Viewer role cannot mutate and every accepted mutation records actor and role
SSE and cursor APIs expose append-only event updates
